active.title: P1 Durable Stop terminal receipt
active.question: Does an actual Stop return only after the authoritative session.stopped event and stopped checkpoint/snapshot are durably persisted and visible through the receipt surface?
active.method: Reuse existing owners and tests before adding any new harness. No source patch until a focused persistence acceptance proves a gap.

owner_map.adapter: electron/agent-runtime-adapter.js AgentRuntimeAdapter.stop() preserves completed sessions and delegates running sessions to UnifiedAgentService.stop()
owner_map.service: src/agent/executive/UnifiedAgentService.js stop() aborts LiveAgentCore and delegates terminal-state ownership to AgentSessionRuntime.stop()
owner_map.session_router: src/agent/executive/AgentSessionRuntime.js stop() resolves the session and delegates to AgentExecutive.stop()
owner_map.terminal_authority: src/agent/executive/AgentExecutive.js stop() appends session.stop_requested, aborts the active attempt, waits for the run loop, then ensures session.stopped plus _checkpoint('stopped') before returning
owner_map.durable_store: src/agent/executive/AgentEventStore.js append() writes events.jsonl; checkpoint() atomically writes checkpoints/<id>.json and snapshot.json; writes are awaited/serialized
owner_map.receipt_projection: UnifiedAgentService.receipts() projects persisted executive events with eventId as receiptId and lists checkpoints

proves: completed durable sessions are preserved rather than terminalized again
an in-flight session delegates to the authoritative stop path exactly once
does_not_yet_prove: session.stopped exists in persisted events.jsonl after Stop
receipt projection exposes the durable terminal receipt after Stop

proven_findings.detail: AgentExecutive.stop is the terminal-state authority. AgentEventStore is the durable persistence owner. UnifiedAgentService.receipts projects stored event IDs as receipts and lists checkpoints.
test/agent-runtime-adapter-stop-lifecycle-smoke.js proves exactly-once delegation for running sessions and preservation of completed sessions, but not durable event/checkpoint persistence.

next_acceptance.question: Is durable Stop persistence already covered by an existing lower-level AgentExecutive/AgentEventStore regression?
next_acceptance.observable: Inspect existing tests for AgentExecutive, AgentSessionRuntime, AgentEventStore, session.stopped, checkpoint('stopped'), events.jsonl and snapshot.json before adding any test or changing source.
next_acceptance.falsifier: If an existing regression already proves the durable Stop event/checkpoint/snapshot/receipt path, reuse and run it. Only if no such regression exists may a focused test extension be planned.
